definition: A protein encoded by the PSMD12 gene (also known as RPN5) that functions as a structural non-ATPase subunit of the lid within the 19S regulatory particle of the 26S proteasome. In the context of Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome, heterozygous disruption or haploinsufficiency of this subunit impairs the ubiquitin-proteasome system and intracellular protein homeostasis, causing a neurodevelopmental syndrome characterized by developmental delay, intellectual disability, dysmorphic features, and congenital anomalies.

source.title: De novo disruption of the proteasome regulatory subunit PSMD12 causes a syndromic neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: PSMD12, encoding the non-ATPase subunit PSMD12 (aka RPN5) of the 19S regulator of 26S proteasome
